scope: AutoDL RTX 4080 SUPER; StreamingBench samples 201-250; HERMES KV 4000/6000/50000

metric_definitions.ttft_seconds: Existing LLaVA question_answering timer. It excludes video ingestion and pseudo-query compression and ends after the first selected token is passed through another decoder forward.
metric_definitions.reported_peak_allocated_gb: Existing torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated readings divided by 1024^3. The counter is process-lifetime and is not reset per video or question.
metric_definitions.reserved_memory: Unavailable: the logs contain no torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved measurements.
metric_definitions.answering_cache: Minimum/maximum layer KV length after temporary question-answer cache entries are truncated. Summary statistics use the maximum.
metric_definitions.video_processing_seconds_tqdm: Difference in coarse whole-second outer tqdm cumulative times; includes per-video loading/processing but excludes process and model startup.
metric_definitions.total_runtime_minutes_notebook: Notebook wall time around each inference subprocess from exports/run_summary.csv.

limitations: Derived from existing logs; no new GPU measurements were collected.
Reserved memory and isolated encoding/compression durations are unavailable.
TTFT is not end-to-end question latency or streaming throughput.
Cross-GPU runtime comparisons are not hardware-independent.
